answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own plume record, and its own share of the ferrous quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The canyon ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2081 identities would post 2815 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
